name: LTX 2.3 22B Distilled (Official)
description: Official Draw Things preset for LTX 2.3 22B distilled video generation
notes: VIDEO MODEL: LTX 2.3 22B distilled 1.1 generates video with synchronized audio. Draw Things supports 9-257 frames (9 = 8+1, quick for testing; official default is 121). Fixed 25 fps output. Hires fix generates at 640x384 then upscales to 1280x768. Audio arrives as fpzip-compressed CCV tensor blobs. Use --num-frames to override frame count. Model: LTX-2.3 22B [distilled] 1.1 (6-bit)
